subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt the four-PR lineage accounting architecture, or retain the current scanner and land only the narrower fork-identity/cache repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both paths address the same user-visible overcount but establish different permanent accounting and cache boundaries; correctness tests cannot decide which maintenance and rollout model the repository wants to own.

options.title: Adopt the lineage stack
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order while keeping legacy authoritative until the promotion evidence is complete.

options.title: Prefer the narrow repair
options.body: Land the focused identity and cache invalidation work from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause or close the larger lineage stack pending stronger evidence that a rearchitecture is necessary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order while keeping legacy authoritative until the promotion evidence is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits show direct ownership of the current scanner behavior, and this decision determines the repository’s permanent accounting architecture.
